intro: Government and critical infrastructure organizations were the primary focus of the 18 CISA-related alerts published between April and August 2026, with the United States and global operations most affected. The reporting highlighted 15 high-severity and 3 critical incidents, involving threat actors GRU, Interlock, and Lazarus Group. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2024-57726, CVE-2026-21643, CVE-2026-34197, CVE-2024-1708, and CVE-2026-68820, impacting technology, defense, and aerospace sectors across North America, Brazil, and Europe.
